prompt: Summarise in one sentence: An event log stores every state change as an append-only record, so current state can always be rebuilt by replaying history, and any past state can be reconstructed.

A daemon writes an append-only log. Explain the trade-off between fsyncing on every commit versus letting the OS schedule it, and say which you would pick for a log whose entire value is being trustworthy after a crash. Justify the choice.
note: Judgement verb plus a real trade-off. Should classify to strong.
